input.quote: NO DAMAGES FOR TERMINATION. NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR DAMAGES OF ANY KIND, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES, DAMAGES FOR THE LOSS OF GOODWILL, PROSPECTIVE PROFITS OR ANTICIPATED INCOME, OR DAMAGES RESULTING FROM ANY EXPENDITURES, INVESTMENTS, LEASES OR COMMITMENTS MADE BY EITHER PARTY ON ACCOUNT OF THE TERMINATION OR EXPIRATION OF THIS AGREEMENT IN ACCORDANCE WITH ITS TERMS.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty, stipulated-sum or early-termination/minimum-fee provision is payable by us anywhere in the Agreement. Payment obligations (Article V user fees, the $2,500/month support fee, Supplemental Payments and taxes) are usage- or service-based consideration, not stipulated damages. Article IV (p0049) preserves only Licensor's right to receive payments for trades actually performed on early termination — no acceleration of remaining term fees — and Article XXI (p0138) imposes only return/certification duties. Article XXIII (p0142) expressly bars termination damages against either party, which cuts in our favour. The two nearest-adjacent items are not Customer-payable LDs: the audit cost-shift on a >5% discrepancy (p0064) is ordinary audit cost allocation, and the payment floor in p0070 simply ties fees to recorded traded volume. The rebate/share mechanics in p0076 run to us. No redline required for this rule; the audit cost-shift and the drafting slip naming "Licensor" in p0070's floor are better addressed under the audit and payment-terms rules.
